description: For a table-type, a dynaset, a snapshot and a forward-only recordset over B (20 rows): (a) Move 17 (ID 18), read BOF, EOF and ID, GetRows(5), read, GetRows(5) again, read, MoveFirst, read, MoveLast, GetRows(1) twice, read; (b) fresh: GetRows(20), read, GetRows(1), read; (c) fresh: GetRows(2) x2 with a read between, GetRows(0), read, GetRows(2); (d) empty table E: GetRows(1), read. Asks the short return at the end, the array shape of a partial and of an empty result, the position and BOF/EOF after each, and a second call at EOF. The fixture copy is opened read-only.
retentionNote: Designed r-cursor-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
